name: ガバナンスとセキュリティの領域メニュー
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Snowflake navigation crop as a faithful Japanese localization. The reference is exactly 339x291 pixels (about 1.16:1). Preserve the narrow vertical sidebar proportions, its plain white background, light-gray separator at the outer edge, small sans-serif typography, compact row spacing, and the original alignment. Do not add any other navigation, app chrome, page content, or floating panels.

At the top, render the small muted section heading 「ガバナンスとセキュリティ」. Directly below it, show the selected row 「ユーザーとロール」 with a very pale blue full-width highlight, blue text, and the small outline pin icon at the right edge. Keep the heading gray and smaller than the navigation labels.

Below the selected row, show these five entries in exact order and with the source's vertical rhythm: 「トラストセンター」, 「ネットワークポリシー」, 「データ品質」 followed by a small pale-gray rounded 「プレビュー」 badge, 「タグ」, and 「データ保護ポリシー」 followed by the same badge. Use dark charcoal text on white for unselected entries. The badges are compact pills aligned inline with their labels, with small dark text and a light neutral-gray fill.

Match the crop's modest left padding, selected-row height, white space, subtle right-edge border, and total 339x291 composition. Keep all seven named rows and both preview badges visible. No icons except the pin on the selected row, no separators between items, no extra text, no shadows, and no added content. Use the supplied crop as the authority for structure, state, spacing, and icon placement.
reviewNotes: Localized the governance/security section heading and all six navigation entries; preserved the selected Users and roles row, pale-blue highlight, pin, two inline Preview badges, spacing and narrow sidebar layout. Candidate 1354x1162 (1.1652:1) vs exact crop 339x291 (1.1649:1), under 0.03% ratio difference. Side-by-side review completed.
